status: offline verification only; formal training is not authorized
preserve_previous_family: PURE veRL b174e508a4469663543cfcb366be78cf199d20bf and original A/B remain unchanged
purpose: Remove direct separator/EOS policy-gradient reinforcement following one complete official signal path; do not claim semantic PRM reliability is fixed.

arms.P_VR_OpenRLHF: Frozen existing answer verifier; outcome reward and official response-level RLOO; no PRM forward.
arms.P_PRM_OpenRLHF: Frozen official PURE PRM scores; signed two-class score, softmin temperature 0.1, official process coefficient 1 and actual-peer-token baseline; no answer correctness signal.

shared_signal_path: Use the same fixed question groups, valid token mask and canonical step/end positions for both arms in offline replay.
Execute pinned process_experiences for the selected reward mode, with token reward_baseline for the PRM branch.
Use reverse cumulative returns, then mask step separator and final response positions to zero, as official OpenRLHF does for both reward modes.
Trim padding, apply the pinned replay buffer normalization once, and preserve all original zero advantages as the code does.
Do not apply veRL whitening first, GRPO group normalization afterwards, or an extra empty-answer reward.
future_runtime_requirements_not_executed: A paired implementation must use the same source family, initial policy, frozen data split, seed, sampler, token budget and evaluator.

Use the official minimum-new-token setting of 1 for both arms; verify its semantics in the actual installed generation backend. This blocks immediate EOS, not every whitespace-only or irrelevant answer.
Persist exact emitted token IDs and separator positions during real-model no-update checks; historical reconstructed IDs are insufficient for end-to-end acceptance.
Verify one normalization in the actual trainer loss path, unchanged policy weights, and shared masking on ordinary correct/incorrect answers as well as empty cases.
All-zero-advantage batches must fail validation explicitly until their runtime handling is specified; do not silently invent a normalization fallback.
Single-A100 LoRA settings remain a resource adaptation, not a claim to reproduce the paper's distributed full-parameter experiment.
not_recommended_as_final_baseline: Only transplanting boundary masking and normalization onto veRL raw advantages. This is a useful mechanism ablation, but mixes source families and materially alters P-VR normalization.
known_remaining_limits: Raw PRM scores and their ranking of empty or unhelpful answers remain unchanged.
Empty answer rewards may still affect other responses' baselines.
Nonempty irrelevant content may retain positive advantages.
Boundary suppression also removes normal EOS/separator gradients in P-VR; it is not a neutral software bug fix.
Zero direct EOS loss gradient does not hold EOS probabilities fixed under shared parameter updates.
